newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC NAME JANSEN AS NEW TRAINER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC NAME JANSEN AS NEW TRAINER.

text.p: Celtic named former Feyenoord coach Wim Jansen as the Scottish club's new trainer on Thursday.
The club said in a news conference that Dutchman Jansen would take over from Tommy Burns, who was dismissed in May after three years in charge.
Though Celtic challenged arch-rivals Rangers for the Scottish title last season, Burns was judged to have failed in his task of ending their dominance.
Celtic fans were aggrieved that this year Rangers equalled their record of nine successive Scottish league championships.
Jansen was a busy midfielder with Feyenoord and the Dutch national squad of the 1970s, winning 65 caps for his country.
He made his mark as a trainer with Feyenoord and later had spells as a coach in Saudi Arabia and Japan.
